sentinels.purpose: ZERO GOVERNED READS, ZERO PACMI CALLS AND ZERO X-R1 NETWORK CALLS in the remediation lane. The only git processes run by tests are local configuration listings and credential fills against a .invalid host; no gh or vercel process is spawned by any test.

SUPERSEDES the v1.0.4 SEN-D2 purpose (quoted verbatim in the v1.0.5 amendment, SEN_D2_CORRECTION). Write-set classification: production code and evidence are CLEAN; the files designated in tests/infra-read/expected-detections.json are EXPECTED_DETECTIONS only with EXACTLY their designated per-detector counts; anything else is FAIL. Fixtures are never suppressed globally.
Every value injected by the envelope tests is proven invisible to the secret scanner first, so an envelope refusal can only come from the envelope control.

positive_controls.description: The two materialized certification events (455b5426, 3dc12909) satisfy the CP-1 predicate exactly as dn0ConfigFor configures them.

A recertification of the exact candidate with the certifier's canonical verdict INFRA_CONTROL_PLANE_READ_EXECUTOR_HARDENING_IC_PASS, or ..._PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS, or an unguessed namespace, satisfies CP-1; measureDn0 driven by the REAL dn0ConfigFor verifies all three events.
The constructed gh / vercel environments carry the OS and account context (original spelling preserved) and the fixed values, and nothing else.
The registry X-R1 argv, the preflight argv, the built XCC-1 environment and a REAL local git preflight listing all satisfy the independent normative contract.
A real executor record conforms to the envelope allowlist; a bundle summary conforms to its own.
The DN-0 fetch carries the three resets on argv and the no-askpass / no-prompt environment, and both residual probes run BEFORE it, --name-only.

negative_controls.description: B-1: the entry-point, certification and protocol code carry no verdict-name literal or verdict pattern, and every configured event is exactly {path, packageId, certifiedCandidate}.

CP-1 refuses: wrong candidate, FAIL, FAIL reported with blocking 0, FAIL containing PASS, NOT_PASS, blocking > 0, blocking absent or a string, wrong document class, another package_id, candidate missing or abbreviated, prose containing PASS, lower-case pass, PASS only as a prefix, non-JSON, VERDICT missing; the materialized FAIL satisfies no requirement.
measureDn0 with the real config stops STOP_ARMING_LIMB1_UNSATISFIED for an absent, other-candidate, FAIL, blocking or wrong-class recert.
main() returns 2 with STOP_EXECUTION_NOT_REQUESTED for every incomplete invocation and prints nothing to stdout.

Mixed-case credential names (Gh_Token, gh_token, Github_Token, Vercel_Token, vercel_token) and CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN are refused STOP_CREDENTIAL_OVERRIDE_IN_ENV at invocation, and never carried by the builders.
GH_CONFIG_DIR, GH_HOST, NODE_OPTIONS, proxies, XDG_*_HOME, VERCEL_* and SSL_CERT_FILE are refused STOP_ENV_NOT_ALLOWLISTED; conflicting case variants are STOP_ENV_AMBIGUOUS.
The builders drop every credential, redirection, code-injection, trust and proxy variable from a host-like environment and refuse conflicting case variants.

Free-text detectors fire on a vcp_ token, colon-less and colon userinfo URLs, shell / export / set / PowerShell credential-named assignments (mixed case), and keyword-adjacent 24-char tokens; they stay silent on $ / % references, spaced source assignments, clean URLs and bare 24-char ids.

Write-set classification: an undesignated file with a finding FAILS; a designated file FAILS on an extra or a missing detection; an empty designation FAILS; a stale designation and an empty set are errors.

Envelope: a raw provider object, stdout, an operation key, a non-allowlisted or non-scalar assertion, an absent_fields key, a missing required key and malformed node_ids are STOP_ENVELOPE_NONCONFORMANT; so are extra bundle / rc9a keys and full records in the summary.

Each required XCC-1 reset removed or altered, extra / duplicate -c keys, another subcommand, extra argv, http / other-host / other-repo / userinfo / ssh origins, and every environment deviation are normative violations; registry DRIFT (the op's own fixedArgs lose a reset) is refused by the guard although sameArgv agrees.
The DN-0 fetch is refused STOP_DN0_FETCH_CREDENTIAL_VECTOR, with no fetch issued, when an insteadOf / cookieFile key exists or origin is not https-without-userinfo.
Runtime RC-9a with another GitHub login, or with an environment-supplied token source, stops STOP_RC9_UNRESOLVED.

The battery verdict logic: SURVIVED is never AS_EXPECTED for an expected kill, ERROR never counts as a kill, the v1.0.4 'RED' spelling is not accepted, and the aggregate fails on one survivor or an empty battery.

mutation_controls.description: B-1 reintroduced in the predicate (author-guessed verdict name required) — must be KILLED.
B-1 reintroduced at the entry point (a verdict pattern configured) — must be KILLED.
Candidate binding removed (wrong-candidate PASS) — must be KILLED.
Verdict judged by substring (FAIL containing PASS) — must be KILLED.
gh / vercel env guards reverted to case-sensitive denylists (mixed-case GH_TOKEN / VERCEL_TOKEN) — must be KILLED.
vcp_, URL-userinfo (reverted to user:password), env-assignment and keyword-adjacent detectors removed — each must be KILLED.
A raw provider key injected into the evidence envelope, and the envelope allowlist disabled — each must be KILLED.
Each X-R1 registry reset dropped, the preflight reset dropped, terminal prompt enabled, system isolation dropped, normative guard removed — each must be KILLED.
The battery deliberately fed a behaviour-neutral survivor (--self-test) must report it UNEXPECTED and FAIL.

Retained: GitHub and Vercel exact-shape (POST/body) checks, the Vercel write-operation-id check, G-R1 first (G-R2 before G-R1), RC-9b, RNA-1, freshness, projection, XCC-1 env/listing, stale DN-0 head, post-certification MODIFY, env-value detector, deploy-hook url — each must be KILLED.
DN-0 residual-vector check removed, origin-shape check removed, --name-only dropped, fetch reset dropped, RC-9a identity assertion removed — each must be KILLED.
